cards.text: Moses, Israel's leader, has just finished blessing the tribes of Israel. Now he goes up from the plains of Moab to Mount Nebo, to the top of Pisgah, which faces Jericho. Way up high, the LORD has something for him.

cards.question: Moses is standing at the top of Pisgah, facing Jericho. What does the LORD show him from up there?

cards.text: The LORD shows him everything, from Gilead as far as Dan, across Naphtali, Ephraim, Manasseh and Judah out to the Western Sea, plus the Negev and the whole region from the Valley of Jericho to Zoar. Friend, I spent years peeking at one thin slice of light through a crack in a junk drawer, and Moses gets the WHOLE view.

Then the LORD speaks to him: “This is the land that I swore to give Abraham, Isaac, and Jacob when I said, ‘I will give it to your descendants.’ ” A promise made generations ago, laid out right in front of Moses' eyes.

cards.question: The LORD has let Moses see the promised land with his own eyes. Now the LORD tells Moses he will cross into it.

cards.text: So Moses dies there in the land of Moab, as the LORD had said. And look at the title the passage gives him, friend: the servant of the LORD.

cards.question: Moses has died there in the land of Moab. Who buries him?
The LORD buries Moses in a valley in the land of Moab, facing Beth-peor. To this day, people know exactly where his grave is.

cards.text: Moses was a hundred and twenty years old when he died, and he had just gone up a mountain to the top of Pisgah. Friend, I get winded hopping onto my own gold base, and it's ATTACHED to me.

cards.question: Moses was a hundred and twenty years old when he died. What shape was he in?

cards.text: Down in the plains of Moab, the Israelites grieve for Moses. A whole nation weeping for the man who led them.

cards.question: The Israelites grieve for Moses in the plains of Moab for ___ days, until the time of weeping and mourning comes to an end.

cards.text: Now the passage turns to Joshua son of Nun, and he is filled with the spirit of wisdom. Coming right after Moses? Friend, that's like going on stage right after the headliner brought the whole house down.

cards.question: Joshua son of Nun is filled with the spirit of wisdom. Why?

answers.text: Moses had laid his hands on him
He had fasted alone on the mountain
An angel had appeared to him at night

cards.question: Joshua is filled with the spirit of wisdom. So the Israelites ___ him and did as the LORD had commanded Moses.

cards.text: Then the passage gives Moses his send-off. Since that time, no prophet has risen in Israel like Moses.

cards.question: No prophet has risen in Israel like Moses. What does the passage say set him apart?

answers.text: The LORD knew him face to face
He never made a single mistake
He saw every promise come true

cards.text: And no prophet did all the signs and wonders the LORD sent Moses to do in Egypt, to Pharaoh, Egypt's king, to all his officials and all his land. Meanwhile I can't get through ONE batch without the smoke alarm giving me a standing ovation.

cards.question: No prophet performed all the mighty acts of power and awesome deeds that Moses did. Moses did them in the sight of all Israel.

findings.problem: The card says Moses "has just finished blessing the tribes of Israel," which comes from Deuteronomy 33, outside the passage. That fact has no reference, and the card cites only Deuteronomy 34:1.

rule.text: Facts from outside the passage are fine when they help, like who a new person is or who wrote a letter, with their reference.

findings.problem: The card says Moses "had just gone up a mountain to the top of Pisgah," which comes from Deuteronomy 34:1. The card cites only Deuteronomy 34:7.

rule.text: Every story card cites the verses it tells, from the first verse it uses to the last, no wider and no narrower.

findings.problem: The joke "I get winded hopping onto my own gold base" means he steps off his base and climbs back on. The base never leaves him.

rule.text: The gold base is part of him. He can hop, jump and dive face-first into the chocolate chips, but the base always comes with him. He never steps off it or leaves it behind.

findings.problem: This is Joshua's first appearance in the story, and the card names him only as "Joshua son of Nun." It never says simply who he is, such as Moses' assistant.

rule.text: New people. The first time someone shows up, he says simply who they are, like "Cyrus, king of Persia" or "Moses, Israel's leader."

findings.problem: The question ends with "and did as the LORD had commanded Moses." That tells the baker the Israelites went along with Joshua, which gives away "obeyed" and rules out "doubted" and "resisted."

rule.text: A setup line can't rule out the wrong answers either.
